epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce projects falsely stuck in DECOMPOSING state from 1 to 0
requirements: R1: Correct the readiness calculation logic to correctly transition the project out of the DECOMPOSING state when all deliverables are merged

slices.title: Patch Deliverable Readiness Calculation Logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the calculation fix for this epic, I want to correct the condition for decomposition completion, so that the stagnation warning is resolved when 100% of items are merged
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a project where all 19 of 19 work items are merged,
When the readiness state is evaluated,
Then decompositionComplete evaluates to true and the stagnation warning is dismissed.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase correct DECOMPOSING state resolution rate from 0% to 100%

slices.title: QA Verification for Readiness Calculation
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA verification for this epic, I want to test the corrected state transitions, so that future calculations accurately reflect deliverable progress
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the updated readiness calculation logic,
When tests are executed,
Then unit and integration tests successfully verify the calculation and state transitions for fully merged deliverables.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure 100% test coverage for the readiness calculation edge cases
